Looking out toward the fog bank where the shoals broke white, he pocketed the scroll, took the spiral stairs two at a time, and primed the great brass lamp before dusk even threatened.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市沉入最深处的静谧，只有几盏泛黄的路灯在薄雾中晕开暖光。高耸的玻璃幕墙收敛了白日的喧嚣，沉默地倒映着空旷无车的高架桥。环卫工人的扫帚摩擦着沥青路面，发出沙沙的声响；便利店通宵亮着的灯箱下，蒸包机正腾起第一缕带着麦香的白汽，悄然唤醒沉睡的街巷。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a rule or recipe solves a big task by telling you to do an easier version of the very same task.\n- Each time you do the task, you get one step closer to an ending rule called the base case, which tells you when to finally stop.\n- It works just like Russian nesting dolls: you keep opening identical smaller dolls until you reach the tiny solid one at the center."}
